organisations.name: National Disability Insurance Agency
organisations.notes: Primary statutory body responsible for delivery and financial sustainability of the NDIS, disability-sector development, community awareness, data and research.

organisations.name: National Disability Insurance Scheme Actuary

classification.body_type: Statutory office holder, offices and committees

organisations.notes: Scheme Actuary nominated by the NDIA Board; responsible for assessing NDIS financial sustainability among other duties.

organisations.name: NDIS Independent Advisory Council

classification.body_type: Statutory office holder, offices and committees

organisations.notes: Provides the NDIA Board with independent advice on NDIS design and delivery, including the role of families, carers and other significant people in participants' lives.

organisations.name: National Disability Insurance Scheme Reviewing Actuary

classification.body_type: Statutory office holder, offices and committees

organisations.notes: Reviewing Actuary nominated by the NDIA Board for a maximum term of three years; reviews and reports on actuarial reports and advice received by the Board.

organisations.notes: Reference Group providing strategic guidance for the National Autism Strategy. Source notes supplied are incomplete; additional metadata and URLs to be added.
